# Artisan test fixture notice

The four `official-profile*.alog` files and matching JSON oracle files are unchanged test data from the Artisan project, pinned to release v4.2.0, commit `9334ed75f42a73526bd6da8905164706f06d34fa`. Exact source URLs, byte counts and Git blob identities are in `PROVENANCE.json`. Upstream: https://github.com/artisan-roaster-scope/artisan . Original licensing: GNU GPL version 3; the complete license text accompanies these fixtures as `LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt`.

These attributed files are distributed as regression-test inputs, not as authored application code or user recordings. No Artisan implementation code was copied into the application. The `user-sanitized-v3.0.2.alog` fixture is a privacy-sanitized derivative of the user-supplied sample; free-form personal metadata is replaced, with source/core-series provenance recorded in `PROVENANCE.json`. The private original is excluded from Git and product/source packages.
